Raised ways in the close-up (J-V1.65): (1) a raised part (viaduct, elevated road, aqueduct on a ground part >= 1, generated or declared) is committed before S7b (1) (BCR-39), an input of every stage-2 step; V01 never creates, moves or removes one (generator reason, chance, cap and rung bars base's and V11's, item 110 (f)); V01 owns the bars inside a close-up (T-V1-51). (2) Under-deck strip = ground projection of piers and spans over deck width plus raised.stripMarginM (1 m) each side: a hole in the faces it crosses (boundary-to-boundary cuts), no plot, block interior, seed or hood pin in it; base arch vaults (II.7.6; V04 vault spans) fill it where they exist; an open span stays open ground; DistrictContext.areaM2 and the pre-claim face exclude it.

(3) A part-0 way V01 lays crosses a strip only through an open span (span's use, eager base fact; V04 BCR-45) whose clear width >= way width + raised.clearWidthM (1 m) and soffit >= the crossed class's clearanceCm (V11 raisedWays.structure: cart classes 450 cm, foot 250 cm), within ± raised.squareDeg (30°) of square, never along the strip or through a pier; a seed crossing elsewhere takes F-TEMPLATE rung 1 then rung 2 (shift to nearest qualifying span); a bent-cut lane takes §4.6's ladder and with no span ends at the strip edge as at a reservation. (4) Each ramp or stair end is a part-0 ground vertex with V1-3.6 (4)'s portal gap extended over the rise, an ordinary junction of its class. (5) Pin clearance holds every pier footprint and the strip. (6) An aqueduct arch through a curtain and a raised gate at deck level (C6-46) are wall openings (no gate portal, rank, kind factor, gate plaza, wall-side feature or S9b square). (7) A raised part never bounds a district.

Raised-way land: generated raised parts committed before S7b (1) (viaduct inside S4's route solve, elevated road and aqueduct at S6's end, BCR-39 (a)), so S7b (1)'s capacity subtracts strips (BCR-4 (b)), no household allocated to strip land. A raised part added by an edit (T4 road raised or aqueduct class) removes plots under piers and strip by least disruption (adding edit's fates), households re-homed in V1C-01's order: D's other blocks first (join maximum lowered one step §4.7 S10 (7)), then first district in S7b order with capacity; bend named in one line; none stranded (T-V1-12 fixture). At an epoch (J-V1.79) plots and households under a new strip are V06's clearing (V06 §3.19 (7)) before the commit; the commit's operator then removes the strip's plots as for an edit finding buildings cleared and households in the engine's ledger (re-homing moves nobody); hood.fabric re-derives only crossed districts' reading and pins.

Removing or adding a raised way (J-V1.67): both are the base's edit (item 110 (b): removal of a generated part is an edit whose tombstone holds through regeneration); V01 re-derives every district whose part-0 ways, strip holes or plots the edit changes (crossed districts and those of the base's detour) each from S8 with BCR-33's seam exception, adding its lines to the base edit's dry run; the tombstone's one reader is the base generator (Re-derive from S4 or S6 lays none where one holds); freed strip re-plotted by D's S8 re-derivation; a fabric that fell back for want of room is laid again from the row S7c's keyed pick recomputes when the committed fabric lies on that pick's fallback chain and the fabric path is not edited, never re-drawn.

Deck plots (J-V1.68): (1) a deck's plots and placed landmarks (item 110 (d): frontage plots along a mole, pier or jetty, quay platform or part-0 bridge deck; towers and forts at mole heads and mid-mole) belong to one owning district: mole/pier/quay platform the district whose land face holds its root vertex; bridge the district at its intramural end (inside the outermost enceinte), else Bridge.deck[0]'s when both or neither; a root vertex on a shared chain the smaller id's; they count in owner's inhabitants, S10a allocation, identity; S7b (1) capacity adds the deck row's expected plot capacity (BCR-4 (b)). (2) S9b never types a deck plot. (3) No hood-pin site on a deck plot (mole-head tower or fort a model landmark). (4) Owner's refine close-up includes owned decks (plots, buildings V02 §3.16, landmarks), frame extends, outline over a harbour opens them with their owner. (5) One owner per frontage: bridgehead plaza and square stand on land, deck row's first plot at the abutment; quay platform plots are the deck row's alone (quay onEdge street on land). (6) A fallen or ruined deck: base least-disruption fates; owner's chunk re-derives; no override hangs on a deck plot.

Unit runs, islands, epochs: (1) no generated raised way in a unit run (no route solver or water balance; no aqueduct on an island, V05 §3.22 (5)(d)); a declared one honoured on standalone ground; on an island bent by V05 §3.22 (3)(d) (J-VI.4 (e): raised dropped, stroke drawn as the island's own way). (2) Island terrace rule reads terraceState at the island's relief class: terrainEcho.reliefClass where terrainEcho.relief is own, plain where echo or none (J-V1.94); base levelling raises walls on the island arena (V05 §3.22 (4), BCR-V5-27); no ward-edge wall on or along the rim (rim run sky hard, excluded by BCR-42; levelling stops at the rim strip setback line). (3) Epochs lifting a town to CITY may generate raised ways (V06 §3.19) clearing land first; hood.fabric item (3) re-derives crossed districts' reading and pins (logged in epoch diff, no plot removal or re-homing). (4) Walls over epochs are the base district-edge source in whichever S10 lays a district's plots (V06 §3.19.4 (1)); surviving walls survive; hood.fabric raises no wall.

Aqueduct terminal: one rule reads either form of the public outlet (item 110 (b); V11 aqueduct.terminal): a model Pin of kind fountain (or the base's basin kind when it adds one) or a conduit_house frontage (V11 class; V02 §3.17 (b)); when the outlet stands in or fronts a square face (S9b square, template plaza, main plaza) it is that square's centrepiece: S11's centrepiece draw skipped and V1-3.8.2 step 2 counts it as a prior fountain pick; both forms exist before S11 so the skip is decided at S11. Bar: 0 squares with two fountains (T-V1-51 (g)).

Stage 2 adds no event kind: every stage-2 state is edited by §7.1's existing events with dry run, fate report, one undo step and migration; every tool is one of the twelve with at most one new parameter (BCR-12). No wrong answers (item 101 R2; J-V1.50): every dry run bends a request to the nearest lawful one with one line; refuses only what item 20 forbids (dossier fact) and a lock protects, then offers rejectSite or 'unlock first' (§7.7).

Fabric (layout card): one undo group setAttr(D.fabric, r) then regenerate({ids:[D]}, 'keep'); tool T8 fill with fabric (L3); scope D from S8 with seam exception + BCR-33, plus V04/V05 cross-arena consequences; others byte-identical; bend: infeasible template bent to its fallback and named; no room -> bent-cut; catacomb source stays. Template parameters (plaza size, void, quay on water, ring jitter, through radials, street width): setAttr(D.fabricParams.k, v) + regenerate grouped, T8 'more'; out-of-range clamped and named. Auto: setAttr(D.fabric, 'auto') clears the edited mark so S7c sets it + regenerate. Same layout new seed: regenerate newRandom, T10 hold, shift+click (§14 keymap), D from S8 fabric kept with cross-arena consequences.

Block content (houses, manor, square, green, yard): setAttr(B.content, c) (and squareType), T9 shape on a block (L3); scope D from S10a (iii) with recorded rerolls: S10a (i) placements kept (a field-driving item on B re-placed by (i)'s scoring on D's other candidates), S9b not re-run, S10a distribution re-run for D and the receiving district when D cannot re-house, only blocks whose allocation changes re-derive; B's content held. Bend: displaced households re-homed by S10a's order (§4.5 (5): D's other blocks with join maximum lowered one step, then first district in S7b order), named in one line; manor edit with no top-band household bends to the largest residential class the band range admits; catacomb source/entrance plot allowed (closed source named, V04 §3.5.1 (8)); refused only for locked, pinned or dossier-backed plot on B -> 'unlock first' / rejectSite.

Square function setAttr(B.squareType, t), T9: B's S11 centrepiece re-drawn, place renamed by §6.3 case (4), listed; t not sited -> bent to nearest sited type. Way surface setAttr(W.surface, s), T9 on a way: display only, edited path held. Place name/knowledge/label: setAttr(P.name), setAttr(P.knownTo), moveLabel, hideLabel, delete(P) (removes the name never the place), T11 name (L4), uniqueness §9.6; dossier-owned name refused as dossier-owned with display text offered (§9.1). New local place: setAttr(P.name) on a new HoodPlace from the event seq, T11 on the unnamed face; duplicate name bent to next unique form.

Hood pin: instance {entity B, ordinal hood:<n>, op move/remove/restyle (InstanceStyle.pinKind may change kind, BCR-34)} preceded in the same group by a closeup event when D has no CloseupRecord; T9 (L3) drag, delete, restyle; scope the pin alone, chunk re-derived (§8.10); move off B's faces -> nearest point on them. New hood pin: instance {entity B, op add, point, style {pinKind}} (user ordinal u<n>; with closeup event when needed), T6 place furniture stamp (L2; BCR-12, BCR-35); a point on a footprint, access symbol or way corridor -> nearest clear point. Busy-ness: closeup {district, strategy, params {pinGate}}, T12 dress slider (L4), pinGate outside [0,2] clamped and named. Framing: style closeup.vignette (setStyle), T12. Outline close-up: no event, a view gesture (V09 lays it out).

Stage-2 switch (hood.constants fabric.extensionWeight): editTable on hood.constants or editPreset on the active preset's entry (§7.6), tables editor or presets dialog (§7.4 row); Re-derive from S2 with carry-over (stages before S2 byte-identical; held inputs kept); value outside [0,1] clamped (column range), named. Lone neighbourhood: generate with Recipe.product hood and Recipe.hood, later adjust (Re-derive from S0), T1 intend product hood (L0; BCR-12); whole document with carry-over of edited entities; outline below one block scaled up and named. Outline: adjust(hood.outline, polygon) from handles (T1/T2), Re-derive from S0; not simple -> F-OUTLINE repair shown. Hillside: adjust(hood.edges.slope, {bearingCdeg, pct}) (Re-derive from S0), T1 hillside edge dragged downhill (L0); Terraces with no slope -> default hillside named; pct outside [0, 60] clamped, named.

Ward terracing: one undo group setAttr(D.terrace, on/off/absent) then regenerate({ids:[D]}, 'keep'); T8 'more' chip Terraces auto/on/off (L3); D from S8 with BCR-33 seam exception, walls re-raised by its own S10 (BCR-42); neighbours byte-identical, their wall profiles recomputed; 'on' where walls false bends: contour streets laid, no wall, one line. Raised way crossing D (remove generated, add): the base's edit (item 110 (b) tombstone; T4 road raised, aqueduct class) routed from the neighbourhood panel (T4, L1; V09 lays out); every district whose part-0 ways, strips or plots change from S8; added part removes plots by least disruption and re-homes households, named. Retaining wall (draw; move or delete declared): base events (item 110 (a)), T3 wall retaining kind or T2 terrace stroke edge (L1-L2); base edit's own scope, the holding district's chunk stale, the wall a fixed input later; drawn wall meeting a shared chain snapped off to its drawn side.

Everything else inside a close-up is a base entity edited as one (II.4), no closeup event: lanes and names (setAttr, moveLabel), plots (split, join, setAttr), buildings (setAttr, setEntrance ...), locks, assignments, the square's centrepiece model Pin (setAttr, delete, instance), greens (drawGreen, tree brush). Demolishing fates over a stagnant catacomb (replace close-up or content edit) list blockLifted; a refine close-up never emits one.

Tool parameters: T1 intend gains product town/hood; hood card asks shape (outline thumbnails, 'by the layout' default, or draw), size chips small/medium/large (~85, 700, 1 050 houses) or house count or hectares, kind (hood.kinds cards plus 'great houses' and 'slum' wealth presets), leafy, secular, layout card (Auto + eleven rows), wealth and density sliders, optional water (sea, canal, river), wall or hillside edge by dragging a side (fall default 20 %); no layer toggles; emits generate with Recipe.hood. T8 fill gains fabric id or auto on a district scope with row params behind 'more' (streetWidthM, plazaScale, squareVoid, quayOnEdge, ringJitter, ringRadials, terraceSpacingM) and chip Terraces auto/on/off; emits one undo group setAttr + regenerate; three variations (§7.3 item 10) = next three distinct rerolls under the chosen fabric. T6 place gains the furniture stamp (hood.pins kinds) emitting instance. T11 name on an unnamed court, yard or square creates its place. T12 dress gains pinGate slider and vignette; setLayer hides hood pins with pins layer and block trees with trees layer. Canvas, clerk API and skeleton expose them identically; skeleton quarter carries fabric (BCR-35) and terrace (BCR-44).

Locality (oracle): opening/closing/re-opening no event, digest unchanged, chunks and display deltas only products (T-V1-15); fabric change or New random: outside D's effective scope byte-identical (II.4 seam exception + BCR-33), scope incl. V04 §4.3 and V05 §4.3 cross-arena rows predicted by the oracle; inside: held entities and fixed inputs kept, rest re-derived with carry-over and fates listed; block content: D's blocks with unchanged S10a allocation byte-identical, receiving blocks re-derive from S10 with recorded rerolls plus their cross-arena consequences; hood pin: overrides row and chunk only; place or surface edit: attribute and label/marks only; terracing change: as fabric change, neighbours' walls byte-identical with profiles recomputed; raised way removal/addition: changed districts from S8, others byte-identical; declared retaining wall: holding district's chunk stale, fixed input later; stage-2 switch: stages before S2 byte-identical, from S2 re-derived with carry-over, underground re-derived by its tail with the opening pass (V04 §4.3 switch row, §3.10), never byte-identical.

Undo/lifecycle rows for §7.4: setAttr(D.fabric/fabricParams.k): log + district leaf; S7c keeps edited path, D re-derives from S8; group undo restores attribute and D's undo record (successions reversed); unknown row -> bent-cut reported. setAttr(B.content/squareType): log + block leaf; S9b keeps edited path; a re-derivation from S8 succeeding B carries the edit to B's successor by the anchor rule else orphaned reported; undo former content and D's S10a distribution (and receiving district's); absent ordinary, market -> trading. instance on hood pin: log + Block.overrides; resolved each derivation by §8.10; inverse; row whose kind a new table version drops -> orphaned reported. closeup: log + CloseupRecord; kept across re-derivations, carried to anchor successor; restores former record, first closeup undoable only when no live instance with seq above since; tableVersion kept within §6.4 window then migrated with report.

Undo/lifecycle rows (cont.): setAttr/delete on a HoodPlace and T11-created place: log + place leaf + naming record; succeeded place keeps edited name, deleted name stays deleted (tombstone keeps address), created place stays while host face exists; undo record (created place's undo removes it); §7.5. setAttr(W.surface): log + way leaf; V1-3.7.3 keeps edited path; undo record. generate/adjust of Recipe.hood: recipe; Re-derive from S0; former value; product absent -> town, class-named kind migrated. quarter with fabric or terrace (BCR-35, BCR-44): log (sugar expansion); S7c and terraceState keep declared paths; expansion's undo; absent fabric -> S7c's, absent terrace -> derived. setAttr(D.terrace): log + district leaf; terraceState reads it, S7c weight, district-edge source, elevated-road generator follow; group undo; absent derived. editTable/editPreset on the stage-2 switch: log row operation and confirmed fates; Re-derive from S2 with carry-over, underground tail after; the document as it stood (fates reversed); §7.6 table-row migration.

WhyProviders registered by @plat/hood (V10 §2.13, BCR-V10-3), each a pure function of committed state (same before and after save, load or unrelated edit; T-V1-37): district.fabric ('declared by the user' or χ̃ over committed allocation, eligible rows with weights incl. shade and chain terms, keyed uniform; committed fabric on the recomputed pick's fallback chain reported as the pick bent to it; otherwise differing pick sets V10's evaluated.drifted with cause; fabric stands); block.content/squareType (quotas, siting rule, score terms prestige, spacing, sun, siting pushes as WhyPulls of families SUNLIGHT, EMITS, SENSITIVE, keyed pick, or declared; fixed input names why it stayed ordinary); HoodPlace names (grammar feature fired); hood pins (site, gate terms, prior picks, decay; override state byOrdinal, rematched, orphaned); ladder records (V10 members answer: step type, range, count, member ids once); unwalled side (V10 closure answer); openings and voids (cause AccessPoint; districtsAbove; void only to an admitting key); district.terrace (state and source); ward-edge wall (producer BCR-42 and derived step BCR-43, or 'drawn by the user'); empty under-deck strip or pier hole (raised way and recorded reason item 110 (f)).

Close-up panel reader query query({kind:'hood', id:D}) returns name, identity (with QUARTER label), fabric, population, ladder records with members in D (here; elsewhere with districts), chains in context, voids the key admits, shade share, terrace state, raised ways crossing it (way, kind, reason), bends of the last re-derivation; V09 lays it out; panel offers beside layout cards remove on a generated raised way (base removal with dry run), T4's raised add, Terraces chip. Clerk proposals are previews of T8 (with three variations), T9, T6 furniture shown as ghosts with a one-line reason (§14 clerk contract); critiques of a skeleton add: declared fabric whose requirement fails on the declared quarter, squares short of quota with no sited block, a quarter whose identity has no anchor; clerk sees a court's or yard's name only when its key admits local at the band (§9.2).

Hosts: a host sends these events through the bridge like any (§11.3); a dossier naming claim may name a HoodPlace (§7.7 item 82), making it dossier-owned; stage 2 changes nothing in the bridge protocol.

hatched family (BCR-14): roles and values are §8.2's hatched column; lighting §8.4 (h) (prism pass every rung, night glow); V1-5.1 states programs, order and stage-2 marks at every band so hatched can draw a whole town (VIS-9: every family defines all four bands).

hatched per band: city: block ground paper, footprint masses in lit roof tone (building) with band outline, street stripe in road (§8.5 selection), square blocks and plazas in road, green blocks/parks/wood in green/tree, water, walls, one prism shadow pass, labels §9; district: city + two-tone roofs by roofConstruction (fakeGablePerWing over stored wings until stage 3 registers, then roofscape('twoTone') over facets, V02 §5.2-§5.3), roof law tones, footprints outlined, yards by role, boundary treatments, entrance ticks, every way stroked with casing, courts in court, crowns (lobed, two greens); neighbourhood: district + hatch on every roof facet, road surface programs, stepped ticks, hood and model pins with prism shadows, ground access symbols the key admits, chimneys, large-tree pins under buildings and block trees above (item 58 (d)), place labels (openings included), every named way labelled, addresses (§9.3), close-up title and vignette when opened; building: per-facet hatching, plan rung as ink's once stage 3 exists.

Item 110 marks: retaining walls from the district band (retaining); raised parts at every band by §8.5 way selection above ground ways with shadow (raised); stair and ramp intervals from district band (way.stair); deck plots and buildings as any; each stepped building's tiers in stack order with shadows.

Roof law: each roof face or facet takes the lit roof colour or dark = lit x lerp(ambience, shadow, α) by its normal against the light (faceLight §8.2), α the sheet's shadow alpha (tested by §8.3's hatched census row within ± 0.02); lit colour per building = roof role's pick (§8.2 multi-colour rule) scaled by 2^(0.3 x s), s a centred bell of three uniforms from the building's render.instances stream (ref:NG 1.2.2 roof tone code), clamped per channel.

Hatch (item 58 (e); J-V1.47, J-V1.69, J-V1.73): per roof facet of roofConstruction: under fakeGablePerWing (every sheet before stage 3 registers and the NG parity sheet until M6b) each wing's faces by RoofSpec.kind (gable/hip two faces split at ridge; flat one level face; pyramid, tent, skeleton one face per eave; cone or dome one surface); under roofscape each RoofFacet. Lines at world pitch hatch.pitchM (model length; default calibrated at M5 so census mean 17-19 per wing on B-ZOOM's neighbourhood reference view, starting 0.8 m); direction: sloped facet parallel to its eave (gable/hip under fakeGablePerWing parallel to ridge across the footprint), flat facet parallel to wing OBB major axis, cone/dome concentric rings at world pitch; every line clipped to its facet; each line's two boundary crossings carry a filled tapered triangle (base one stroke 0.5 px at 1x, pointing inward to ½ x m3 x chord; ring: two tapers at the light axis); per ridge-bearing wing two heavier tapers from ridge ends inward (0.3 + 0.2u) x ridge length, base 1 px (ref:NG 1.2.2 hatch code); flat facet adds parapet (V02 parapetCm) as one inset outline in the up-normal lit tone; none roof no hatch.

Hatch (cont.): below 1.5 px on-screen pitch [hatch.minPx] every second line by index parity (zoom-stable subset, never re-spacing); no ridge stroke, outline footprint only (NG BG-3); draws are the wing's render key's (never re-scatter); a wing's triangles emitted into its tile's one hatch path per role (§8.1 hatch mark) so draw calls stay within §12.5's 80; census counts per wing 15-20 per gable/hip wing on the NG parity sheet incl. ridge tapers, line count invariant across the band's zoom; details off: no hatching incl. ridge tapers (NG E1, E6); shadows off: hatch turns 90° to the eave; the parity subset and switches apply to every facet.

Stair flights (V02 stairFlight; X24): flight facet as V02 paints it, treads hatched across by V02's stairTreads(w) (n - 1 lines at goingCm), no ridge tapers; below 2 px of plan per tread lines omitted as V02 omits them; drawn after the wing it rises from and before the wing it lands on.

Crowns (J-V1.27): lobed crown k = 5 + floor(4u) lobes, each a circular arc centred on a jittered k-gon at 0.55 of crown radius (radial jitter ± 0.1), lobe radius 0.5 of crown radius, union outline in shaded tone; lit cap same construction at 0.65 scale offset toward light by 0.15 radius in lit tone; details on: two inner rings of short arcs; two greens (tree role list) by §8.2 pick rule; stamped per crown size class like §8.10's library. Order: large-tree pins in the pins slot under buildings; block trees (Greenery instances) in the tree slot above, smaller crowns first within a block (item 58 (d)).

Road surfaces (by Way.surface; square faces by residue surface): cobble = road fill + stipple of small irregular polygons (5-7 sides, 0.35-0.5 m) at 0.6 m spacing stroked ink α 0.35, kerb line of dots at 1.2 m each kerb; paved = setts 0.6 x 0.3 m rectangles across the way staggered half a sett stroked α 0.3; dirt = plain road fill; planks = bars across at 0.3 m stroked α 0.4; one shared stamp tile per surface kind (§8.10 stamp; 12 m world-anchored tile once per sheet) as clipped pattern fill, never per way; kerb dots per way. Street stripe = model width x roads.widthRatio (hatched default 0.4, ref:NG road width ratio code) read by full and outlined modes; roads.mode full (default fill and surface), outlined (casing 2 x thin stroke then fill and surface), dashed (centreline 9:6 x stroke, no fill, ref:NG road dash), hidden. NG road modes and surfaces are the reference (II.4); stone shapes and spacings ours.

Stepped ticks across a stepped way every 1.2 m of ground length at the thin stroke from the district band. way.stair: a stair interval at a retaining wall draws step ticks across the way over the interval every 1.2 m; a ramp interval draws two hairlines converging toward the upper end; neither changes shape or other marks. retaining: double line in wall (face and coping), ticks toward the low side every 1 m, buttresses (base table row) as filled rectangles on the low side, shadow in slot 9 cast from the high side's level by the pins' prism law, height the derived step (BCR-43). raised: deck body in road (aqueduct channel in water between two wall lines), parapet line in wall each side, piers as filled footprints in wall (slot 11), span openings dashed in the strip at district band and finer; shadow by prism law from deck height in the pass before slot 14.

Pin symbols (model and hood pins, by model size): well round (render key parity) or square stone rim in wall with ink α 0.8 shaft; pump small square with handle tick; trough thin rectangle in wall with water strip; fountain stone disc with water basin shaded to far side; large_tree lobed crown; statue plinth with figure dot; monument plinth with slender triangle; bandstand octagon hatched like a roof; cross glyph on plinth; shrine small square with ridge hatch; every symbol casts its prism shadow at heightM (§8.4 (h); tree: crown outline shifted), read by S5 (e).

Ground access symbols (by accessSymbolKind, sized access.<kind>M; only ground-face accesses outside footprints): stair rectangular rim in wall round four step ticks narrowing to lower end; ladder two rails three rungs in a square rim; hatch small square with hinge line and one diagonal; door no symbol (vault infill base's); cellar_stair small rectangle three step ticks; shaft square rim with ink α 0.9 void; broken-through well rim with dark shaft and crack tick; grating square with three bars; sinkhole irregular rubble ring round a dark centre shaded away from light; mouth dark arc in the slope face with rock fringe; collapsed_shaft rubble disc with dark hollow; ruin_entrance two short double-lined walls flanking step ticks (g 109 (g) masonry style); catacomb small pitched hood over step ticks with a cross tick; state form §8.2's access row; in the pins slot; no shadow but mouth's and catacomb hood's.

hatched layer order at neighbourhood and building bands (StyleSheet.order per band §8.2; city and district take the shared list; NG 1.2.2's order greens, roads, shadows, pins (large-tree pins under buildings), buildings, chimneys, block trees, title is a subsequence, §8.3 order parity): 1 paper; 2 water; 3 ground.block (paper; §8.5 figure-ground); 4 relief (off by default); 5 greens, parks, green blocks, yard parts by role, courts; 6 way casings (pass 1); 7 way bodies, square faces, road surfaces (pass 2; ground.square); 8 river casing and body, shore marks; 8b retaining walls (under shadows, over river); 9 prism shadows (each building's ground shadow from its stack envelope; walls, towers, pins, crowns; each retaining wall's shadow high to low side); 10 pins (model pins, hood pins, ground access symbols, large-tree pins; layer pins); 11 landmark footprints, raised-way piers (wall); 12 buildings (roof faces, outlines, hatching; wings in stack order with upper tiers' shadows); 13 chimneys and roof detail; 14 piers and bridges, raised decks (shadows in a pass just before this slot over everything below, roofs included); 15 fields; 16 block trees (layer trees); 17 boundary treatments; 18 curtain walls; 19 towers and gate blocks; 20 grid; 21-25 scale bar, compass, labels, title and legend, live layers.

Stacks in slot 12 (item 110 (c)(f); V02 X24): a building's wings drawn in stack order by BaseWing.on depth (V02 §2.6), a wing before the wings standing on it, ties by wing key (V02 §2.1 canonical order); after each carrying wing, the prism shadows of the wings on it drawn clipped to its roof in shadow tone at shadow alpha (slot 9's law); slot 9 keeps only the ground shadow from the stack envelope; a stair flight after the wing it rises from and before the one it lands on. Light pass (§8.4) over slots 1-20; §8.2's slot-resolution rule per band (loader refuses a hatched sheet whose neighbourhood list leaves a semantic unplaced). Layer toggles (T12 setLayer; NG F1): hood pins, model pins and access symbols in pins layer; block trees in trees layer; access symbols obey the pins toggle and the key's admission both.

hatched night is §8.4 (h)'s (ambience wash, glow per lit building at the vector rung; placed lights §4.7 light streets); §8.2 states rows apply with hatched tones; a ruined or Works-stage building's hatch replaced by its state program.

closeup.vignette (style value): none (default); fade: every mark outside the opened district at α 0.45 through the compositor (never re-rastered); plateau: opened district's footprint-cloud hull dilated by one block depth drawn as a paper face over a drop shadow (shadow tone, offset along the sun direction by 1.5 m at scale) with everything outside at α 0.25; view data only, never in a digest, never exported unless the export's style carries it.

Item 110's other homes: RetainingWall record, sources, drawing; raised ways, arena parts, piers, ramps, stairs, vaults, generation at CITY/METROPOLIS or declaration at TOWN; deck plots themselves; second fixture's skeleton and bars (V12) are the base's and named volumes'; which classes build in tiers with chance and cap and the deck budget row V11's (X16, X17); plans of tiers V03 (X18); ruin decay V04 (X19). V02 designs the building part only.

Data model units the base's (integer cm on the lattice, centidegrees, table cells in declared units per §7.6's {value, unit, provenance, calibratable}, converted to cm at read and snapped); records are persisted (building leaf digest and snapshot), lazy (held in elaboration cache outside both digests until an edit stores it) or derived at read (pure, never stored); V02 adds no entity kind: every new record is a sub-record of Building (lifecycle its building's; a lock on it an attribute-level lock on its path).

WingRole = main (the range the entrance hint names), range, cross (cross-wing through the main range's end at a butt joint), block (pavilion splitting the range it straddles; always hipped, never a pyramid, item 59 ADOPTED, J-V2.3; often a storey taller), back (rear range or outshot), service (lower range of the same building), tower (polygon wing with cone or pyramid roof at a corner, end, front, or on a block; church west or crossing tower), turret (small tower in a re-entrant corner, stair turret), gate (front range of a closed ring carrying the gate hall), part (base template or axis-locked composer part), shelter (cluster structure), tier (stepped stage, tier k >= 1 on tier k - 1), shrine (small roofed range on a stepped top), stair (solid flight climbing a tier's face).

MassingFamilyId = single, L, T, H, U, cross, plotRing, towerHouse (historical plan types); regularCourt, starCourt, chordArc, rectCourt, gridWalk (our ids for FM's five layout families, item 59; renamed from PathShapeRow ids by BCR-V2-06's migration row, J-V2.47); row; template, axisLocked, baseOutline (base constructions for institutions, MFCG/FTG presets, last fallback); shelter, drawn; stepped; ovalCourt (elliptical two-ring court, arcaded façade ring and solid seating ring round an open floor; not fantasy).

BaseWing gains role (persisted; written by massing, mutator convert step, setMassing; read by composer, mutator match, roofscape joint priority, exports, anchors), key (stable ordinal written once when minted, never changed, never re-used after removal), arcade? (open ground-storey arcade written by M11 from the row's arcade cell and setAttr(wings/<key>/arcade); read by drawing dashed outline, exports open, §2.6 capacity no ground rooms). Building gains nextWingKey (next free key; = wing count at S11; never decreases) and massing? MassingRef (absent only on an un-upgraded pre-stage-3 document).

MassingRef: family; row (the CompositionRow key reached: template composition value, <class>/<band>, <family>/<band>, default.<arrangement>/<band>, with @underground on the underground layer); grammar (composition.json version read); entrance {wing key, side} or null (entrance hint, BCR-V2-23; null for row, shelter, drawn footprint); segments (path segment count after collinear merging, before M7 splits; FM's count unit; 1 for single, row, towerHouse and base constructions; written by M5, every setMassing op and the mutator; read by parity harness, report, why provider); low? {wing, end 0 or 1} (axis fallLine only: main range's downhill end, V03's byre end; rewritten on reshape); cupola? {kind dome/tip/pyramid, wing} (M12 ornament, drawn and exported, never in Heights, never a caster; dropped when its wing leaves, kept at new midpoint on reshape).

DriftBounds (typed once here): areaPct band around the row's target (default [-15, 15]); floors relative to the row's draw (default [-1, 1]); families? (absent: the row's; before stage 3 registers only baseOutline, template, axisLocked, row, shelter and stepped admitted, any other ignored and reported driftFamilyIgnored, read once stage 3 registers); roofKinds?; classFamily? (§6.3's building class family the assignment keeps).

BaseWing.partName (V03's BCR-V3-13): template part name (nave, transept, crossing, chancel, apse, tower, cloister walk ...) written by base outline builder templates; V02 mints none; M0 (d) passes it through; every V02 wing writer (mutator W-steps, setMassing ops and bends, canonical re-keying, rebaseStack) keeps it on the wing keeping its key (re-joined block pieces keep the lowest key piece's partName); a wing V02 adds carries none; read by M8 (e) (crossing tower over part crossing), cryptSeedWings, V03 A5 (e); lifecycle row V03's (V03 §2.5; S23-15).

RoofSpec gains kind 'shed' (single-pitch) and high? (ring side along which a shed roof stands at ridge height, the side against the host wall; absent on other kinds); a shed wing's ridgeCm is its height at high, eaveCm on the opposite side; written by the massing (M12) and setAttr(wings/<key>/roof).

Canonical wing order (stated once; J-V2.48): Building.wings is always towers and turrets first ascending by key, then every other wing ascending by key; the massing mints keys in that order (M13); every writer (mutator, setMassing, migration row) re-sorts before commit, so §2.6's clip order (towers first) and every derived order are functions of the keys; a tower standing on a block is contained in its block and clipped after its container by §2.6's containment rule.

Wings named by key, never position: under stage 3 Entrance.wing, Porch (via its wing), Room.wing, StairCore.wing, StairCore.tower (key of the tower wing whose round room holds the spiral), Chimney.wing, Storey.wings[], ProgramRoom.wing hold base wing keys; a tower's room names its tower wing's key (no wings.length + offset); a composed wing found by its base key; the base's index reading stays for the base outline builder (keys = indices); adding or removing a wing never re-points a stored door, room, stair or chimney (T-V2-34).

Composed Wing gains base (key of the base wing it composes; 1:1 with non-tower non-turret base wings) and dormerRows (0-2 rows, one per eave side); footprint, heights, roof, spans derived from the named base wing whenever base is set (never stored then); dormers count derived as sum of rows' counts; porch only on the main-entrance wing whose role admits one (WingRoleRow.porch). The composition never re-shapes the massing (J-V2.2, J-V2.6).

DormerRow {eave 0 or 1 (first eave side in ring order is 0), count >= 0 (positions derived by dormerPositions, never stored), widthCm, kind, edited? (set by setComposition: fixed input to the plan rung's step 6, kept through a wings-rung re-derivation while the eave keeps its length within ± 10 %)}; DormerKind = dormer (set back from eave), wallGable (gablet breaking the eave), hoist (warehouse loading dormer), entranceGable (gable over the main entrance bay); PorchKind = hood, gabled, twoStorey, recessed, halfRound (half-disc under a half-cone roof, FM's commonest; weight 0 by default, calibrated under FM); Porch gains kind (side and offset stay the main entrance's, base rule 3).

ComposedTower gains base (key of the massing's tower or turret wing; its ring is that wing's; centre = ring area centroid, radiusCm = largest vertex distance rounded up, heights and roof read from the wing, never stored when base set). Composition gains row, grammar, secondaryPorch? {entrance ordinal (side, rear or yard entrance), widthCm, depthCm} (a hood only, J-V2.44; lazy, stored when an edit stores it; side and offset re-read after every carry); courts derived at read (holes of the footprint face in ring order), never stored.

A stored composition stores only row, grammar, per composed wing its base and dormer rows, the porch, per composed tower its base, and the rooms and plan the base defines; its world points are only the rooms' and plan's, which carryWings carries (J-P48); composed wings and towers follow their base wings, so a stored composition adds no carried ring (J-V2.6).

composition.json: one versioned table file in @plat/tables read through the override layer (§7.6); every cell {value, unit, provenance, calibratable, extension?, presets?}; every calibratable cell has a calibration register entry (V12 §3.11: default, confirming measurement, due milestone, fallback) written by the seat landing its milestone (M3a-V2, M6a, M6b, M6c), plat calibrate register --check green at that exit; a presets.FM measured-rate entry set only by V12's reference run; code-read FM entries (rich rows' families, sunBias 0.5) carry ref:... (code) provenance and move by no run; sunBias's parity-neutral entries under zeroing presets MFCG, FTG, VG (0.5 where zeroing gives 0) are own with note 'fixed: the parity neutral' (V11 §2.2 rule (a)); each column family's metric, method, due and fallback are V2 §3.10.10's line. Readers S11, composer, mutator, roofscape, §8.10. Slice kinds row (CompositionRow, WingRoleRow, MassingGrowthRow), weights (families, porch, tower-shape), bracket (TowerShapeRow.sides).

CompositionRow (one per key and band, compiled from four authored anchors; continuous cells interpolate along prosperity between band centres, discrete cells switch at the cut, item 19): key <prefix>/<band> (template-family key, class id override, structure-role key, default.<arrangement>, outbuilding; @underground suffixed rows per prefix); prefix; band; alias?; families [{family, weight}] (continuous; renormalised over feasible set; must satisfy the arrangement law); axis frontage/fallLine/water (discrete, default frontage); wingWidthM; rangeLenM; crossWing {fwdM, backM}; courtMinM; uOpenFront; blocks; blockStoreyDelta; towers (a towerHouse's own tower not counted); towerShape {round, square, octagon}; towerRadiusW; towerStoreyDelta; towerOnBlock (0 default, calibrated under FM); towerFlat; westTowers (discrete: cathedral 2 at west corners, church 0-1); crossingTower; gateTower; turret; backRange; backLenM; backWidthM; hipShare; gableToStreetMaxFrontM; arcade (discrete); cupola {chance, kinds}; dormer {perTenM, widthM, kinds, entranceGable}; porch weights incl. none; secondaryPorch (0 default, calibrated under FM); rooms {hall (discrete), hallLenShare, chapel, gateHallM} read at the occupants' band; floors? (role row's own storey range); hearths; coverageMax; claimShare? (M10 band = claimShare x area(H); absent on a claim-sized template -> constants claimLo/claimHi 0.35, 0.6); caveaM? (ovalCourt seating ring depth).

MassingFamilyRow (supersedes PathShapeRow; FM's five families keep their rows (P21) under our ids): family, minFrameW (least frame in wing widths), wings (range of ranges before blocks split; M13 checks), closed, joints butt/mitre/either (M13 checks), fantasy (true for regularCourt, starCourt, chordArc; weight scaled by fantasyShapes; D-7), sides?/sideWeights? (regularCourt side counts; starCourt corner counts), chords? (chordArc), gridCells? (gridWalk), provenance.

WingRoleRow {role, storeyDelta, roofKinds [{kind, weight}], hipInset (ridge-end inset share of span, 0.5 equal pitches; ranges 0.5, blocks 0.5 default and 0.25 under FM), through (priority at a butt joint), dormers, porch}; MassingGrowthRow {from, to, keep all/main/mainAndOne/none, anchor front/rear/either} (mutator's family lattice); TowerShapeRow {shape round/square/octagon, sides bracket [{maxRadiusM, n}], roof cone/pyramid, pitch (rise over radius)}; PorchKindRow {kind, depthM, widthM, storeys, clearanceM (kept free in front), outside (false: recessed)}; DormerKindRow {kind, depthShare, atEave, minPitch, gapM} (end margin = constants endMarginM read by facadeBays).

RoleKeyRow (composition.roleKeys): family (V11 template-family key or '*'; family-specific row wins), name (V11 §3.6.1 structure name, e.g. stable, stables, nave and choir, wheel or sails), key (composition key prefix, or yardPart: not a building, or basement: held in the cellar), attach slot (S11 packs its own slot) or main (main slot's massing lays it, BCR-V2-29; M8b). ClassFamilyRow {cls (V07 village class v.<id>), key} (composition.classFamily, one source of their keys, J-V7.82; scope withdrawn, J-V2.96). HeightsRow is V11's (V11 §2.8 heights keyed by template family) read unchanged with BCR-V2-26's attic, parapetCm, towerStoreyCm? whose values V11 §3.6.4 writes once (SCC-20); V02 declares no heights row (J-V2.33). CompositionConstantsRow {key constants, cells}; CompositionTables {rows, families, roles, growth, towers, porches, dormers, roleKeys, classFamily, constants, version}.

Derived at read: RoofEnd = gable, hip, party, mitre, valley, wall, open (per wing end from joints and heights); RoofFacet {wing key, ring, z (cm above building's lowest base per vertex), normal, part roof/dormer/porch/tower/cupola}; roofscape(b, c?): RoofFacet[] (planar, non-overlapping, covering the footprint and a porch outside it); resolveEnds(b): Map<wing key, [RoofEnd, RoofEnd]>; facadeBays(w, side, bayM): {atCm, widthCm}[] (every ring side; integer cm only; valley reaches by §6.5 arithmetic never the float roofscape; implemented in @plat/plots beside massStepped, stairTreads, cryptSeedWings, re-exported by @plat/buildings); dormerPositions(w, row, obstacles); cryptSeedWings(b): wing keys whose ground storeys seed a crypt's ring (called by §2.6's basement function).

Eave sides: a wing's two eave sides are the ring sides parallel to its ridge (ridgeAxis 0: sides 2 and 4; ridgeAxis 1: sides 1 and 3); eave 0 comes first in ring order; a polygon wing has no eave sides (no dormers).

BaseWing.role: create massing S11, mutator add step, setMassing (addRange, addTower, addBlock, backRange); read composer, mutator, roofscape, exports, anchors; persist leaf digest; regenerate Regenerate keep re-derives the same, New random on the plot re-draws with the plot's reroll (§6.1); undo record keeps former wings; migrate base carries it from M1 (BCR-V2-01: base outline builder writes main, range or part), else the fallback migration row. BaseWing.key, nextWingKey: as role; new key = nextWingKey which advances; generation keys 0..n-1 in wing order (M13); undo restores nextWingKey.

Building.massing: create S11 massing, setMassing family, mutator (target family and row); read mutator, deriveEntrances, exports, reader; persist leaf digest; undo restored; migrate an older document keeps its value, one before stage 3 has none and reads as baseOutline until an upgrade re-derives S11 (§7.5; declared shift §13.3). MassingRef.segments, .low, .cupola: create M5, M12, every setMassing op and the mutator; read parity harness, report, why (segments), V03 byre (low), roofscape, paint programs, exports (cupola); regenerate with the massing (same draws); migrate absent -> segments = range-role wing count with block pieces re-joined, low and cupola absent until upgrade.

Crypt lift (ground-storey baseCm of ground wings over the basement's ring, raised form) and half cellar's raise (ground wings over a half basement's ring by cellar.depthCm / 2; for a crypt-only basement the wings over the crypt's ring; BCR-V2-28): create M11 when §2.6's basement function takes the crypt ladder's raised form, basement step when the gate chooses half (gate reads the datum without the raise); read deriveBase's successors, heights, V03 floor levels (choir stairs, 3.3 datum), dig floor, roofscape, casters; persist leaf digest (those wings' Heights.baseCm); regenerate with the basement after setMassing, a mutation or a terrain change, kept by deriveBase and rebaseStack (1) on every re-basing path while half (T-V2-52); undo with wings; migrate: an always-crypt building without it re-derives the basement on load (V03 migrate row, BCR-V3-20); half basements lacking the raise gain it at next upgrade (one-time shift J-V2.91, reported).

BaseWing.partName: create base templates passed through by M0 (d); read M8 (e), cryptSeedWings, V03 A5 (e), why; persist leaf digest; regenerate kept on the key-keeping wing by every V02 writer, absent on V02-added wings; undo with wings; migrate V03's row. RoofSpec shed and high: create M12, setAttr; read roofscape, exports; migrate none before stage 3. BaseWing.arcade: create M11 (row arcade), setAttr(wings/<key>/arcade); read drawing, exports, capacity; regenerate with massing; migrate absent before stage 3.

Composition.secondaryPorch: create composer, setComposition porch with entrance; read roofscape, drawing, exports; persist lazy, stored with the composition; regenerate as the porch; undo restored; migrate by entrance ordinal, a missing entrance orphans it (§7.3 item 4), reported. Composition.row, .grammar: create composer; read elaboration record slices, migration; persist lazy, stored when an edit stores it; regenerate stale rung re-derives from committed state; migrate an older-grammar stored composition keeps stored fields, unstored parts re-derive under the new grammar at next click. Wing.base: 1:1 with non-tower base wings; stored one re-matched by key when wings change; a missing key orphans the composed wing, reported.

Wing.dormerRows, DormerRow.edited: create composer, setComposition dormers (sets edited); read roofscape, plan rung, exports; persist lazy, stored at the first setComposition; regenerate unedited row re-derives on the wing's own stream, edited row kept while its eave length stays within ± 10 % else orphaned and reported; undo keeps the former row; migrate by wing key. Porch.kind: create composer, setComposition porch; regenerate as dormer rows, side and offset re-read from the main entrance after every carry (rule 3). ComposedTower.base: one per tower or turret wing, follows the tower wing, migrate by key. Composition as a whole: create wings rung (and rooms with the plan); read §8.6, plan rung; persist elaboration cache (non-canonical §2.9), model data once stored; regenerate stale -> re-derived at next click; undo restores former composition or removes it when that edit stored it (J-P48 (5)); migrate §7.5 orphan rule.

Fallback migration row (document with no stage-3 fields, from before BCR-V2-01 reached M1): key = index in Building.wings; role by the base outline builder's rule (main for the first rectangle or a row quad, range for other rectangles, part for template or axis-locked part); nextWingKey = wing count; massing absent (read as baseOutline with segments 1 until an upgrade re-derives S11, declared shift §13.3); footprints, heights, roofs unchanged; canonical order holds (base builder lays no tower); BCR-V2-27's index-named fields need no rewrite (key = index).

A base wing's address = its building's with its key, sub-record address ('wing', building, key), matched after re-derivation by BCR-V2-11's anchor rule (role, then ridge midpoint within 0.5 m in the building's frame); composed wing, dormer rows and composed tower addressed through the base wing key; porch by the building; composer's rooms by the base's room:<building>/<level>/<i> (§2.6, §6.3); no record stores a stream key or seed.

Item 110 adds no entity kind: tier, shrine and stair are base wings (sub-records of Building) with fields saying what they stand on and whether solid; a deck building is an ordinary building whose BuildingInput names its deck.

BaseWing gains on? (key of the wing it stands on; floor = that wing's deckLevel; tier k >= 1 names tier k-1, shrine the top tier, stair k >= 1 the tier on whose terrace its foot stands; absent = on the ground, every family but stepped; written by massing ST7, tiers op, mutator's stepped rows, never re-pointed otherwise; read by deriveBase BCR-V2-32, storeyRange, capacity BCR-V2-33, roofscape occlusion and order, carry check BCR-V2-35, exports, V03 X18) and solid? (solid mass, no interior: stepped pyramid rubble tier, every stair: Heights.floors 0, eaveCm its top above baseCm, no storey, room, dormer, porch or capacity; written by ST4, ST5, the ovalCourt seating ring M5, tiers op, mutator (cleared when stepped -> single keeps a solid tier 0 as a storeyed range); read by storeyRange, capacity, M11, composer, V03, exports).

MassingRef.stack? (present exactly when family stepped): shape rect/round/octagon; stairs axial/flights/internal/none (form laid after ST3 fallback; none = sealed stack, lawful only where tier 0 is solid, never a row value, reached only by an edit's bend); lowerRoof flat/pent; top flat/shrine/roofed; insetCm (drawn step d re-used by tiers op); grade (drawn stair rise/run re-used by tiers op); truncated (tiers drawn but not laid, reported).

TierCells (on a row whose families include stepped): count [>= 2 incl. top] drawn uniformly; shape weights rect/round/octagon; aspect (clamp of rect tier 0 width/depth, the laid aspect the drawn stack's own proportion clamped, never drawn, J-V2.86); insetM (step); solid all/lower/none; solidHeightM (tier k x taper^k); tierFloors (tier k x taper^k rounded stochastically, >= 1); taper; lowerRoof flat (walkable terrace with family parapetCm) or pent (skirt rising to the tier above); top weights flat/shrine/roofed; shrine {floors, insetShare, roofs}; stairs axial/flights/internal (none never a row value); stairWidthM; stairGrade range (upper end at most stairGradeMax 1.3); heights? {storeyGroundCm, storeyUpperCm} read only where no HeightsRow passed (V04's ruin), only for a shrine's storeys (stepped-monument 350/300).

Construction contract (J-V2.80), all exported by @plat/plots: massStepped(input, row, band, k) -> KernelResult<{wings, massing}> (the stepped branch: frontage frame steps 1-2, slotBand, ST0, drawTiers on massing creation indices 8-9, layTiers, ST8, M14's attempts on massing/attempt=a with drawTiers re-run, then single fallback ST8, then the base outline rectangle; called by the base outline builder from M3a (BCR-V2-39), stage 3's M5 from M6a; T-V2-46 compares; V04 never calls it); slotBand(input, row, band) -> {lo, hi, cap} m² (one formula for M3, ST0, ST8, M10); massOval(input, row, band, k) (ovalCourt branch M3, M5, M11-M13, same bytes from base builder M3a and stage 3 M6a); drawTiers(cells, storeys, s8, s9) -> TierDraws (ST1); layTiers(input) -> TierLay or TierFailure (ST2-ST7, pure: no draw, budget, stream); BandRead {band, value (manifested, significance-shifted)}.

TierInput {frame {origin, u along frontage, v inward, origin Rr's near front corner}, region {W, D} (fit rectangle Rr), scale (ST8 size factor, 1 at first lay), cells, storeys {groundCm, upperCm} (HeightsRow storeyCm or TierCells.heights for V04), pitch, parapetCm, plinthCm (ruin passes 0 and 0), draws, anchor? (tier 0 ring given: four corners of a kept range or a regular ring), forms? (stair forms to try in order)}; TierDraws {n, shape, insetCm, top, stairWidthCm, grade, tiers [{heightCm without parapet, floors (0 solid)}], shrine?}; LaidWing {ring, kind rect/polygon, role tier/shrine/stair, on index or null, solid, floors, eaveCm, ridgeCm, roof}; TierLay {wings (ST7 order), stairs laid, aspect, truncated, entrance hint by index}; TierFailure {kind noSecondTier/check, step ST3/ST6, detail}.

DeckContext (BuildingInput.deck, written by S11 from the plot's deck record, absent elsewhere): host (Bridge or pier/quay way), kind bridge/pier/mole/quay (jetty is a pier; a raised way's deck carries no plot, J-V2.71), surfaceCm (Bridge.deckCm or pier's, mole's, quay's deck height §4.8, read by the datum step; null exactly for a quay platform built on the bank: that is ground (terrain datum, ordinary basement gate, dig floor) while kind quay keeps the @deck rows and deck budget; a ford or draw Bridge or one with no deckCm offers no deck plot (X28)), landmark (placed landmark: its class's own rows, no deck budget; copied by S11 from the deck-plot record's landmark flag (X28, the coherence pass)). DeckBudgetRead {footprintM2, maxFloors} from V11's deck table (kind x band; X16); V02 declares no row.

Derived (exported by @plat/plots, built at M3a-V2): deckLevel(w) = w.baseCm + w.eaveCm less the family's parapetCm when w's roof is flat (exact since ST4 adds the parapet to every flat-roofed tier's eave); rebaseStack(b, ground) (J-V2.81): (1) ground wings by §2.6's terrain rule as BCR-V2-32 words it, every sample by ground (deck surface, kept user base, BCR-V2-42 wall-side sample, crypt lift, half raise); (2) every wing with on in stack order, baseCm = deckLevel of its support; (3) every stair's ridgeCm re-set to its true rise and stairSteep re-tested; (4) Building.heights by the envelope rule incl. floors; every re-basing path of such a building calls it instead of the per-wing step, passing ground = levelledGroundCm(doc, key, ·) on its own document and the plot's arena key (S23R3-17), never the raster sampler.

storeyRange(b, w): null for a solid wing; [0, floors-1] storeyed on the ground; for a storeyed wing with on: [t, t+floors-1], t = next(on), next(x) = storeyRange(b,x)[1]+1 for storeyed x, next(x.on) for solid x with on, 0 for solid x on the ground (shrine on a solid pyramid is storey 0; tier above a two-storey tier 0 starts at storey 2); towers, turrets and other wings the base's reading. stairChain(b): per stair wing in key order {stair, from (terrace wing or null ground), to, head ring side (RoofSpec.high)}; empty for internal and none forms and other families. landingSide(b, w): for a storeyed wing with on, the ring side nearest the head of the stair arriving on its terrace (axial front side; flights the last flight's head side); null for internal and none; where V03 opens its landing door (X18) and on a solid stack roots the plan (BCR-V2-41).

stairTreads(w) (J-V2.90; J-S23.6): the one tread law of a stair wing: n = ceil(rise / riserMaxCm) equal risers (rise = w.ridgeCm, true rise kept by rebaseStack (3); riserMaxCm 20 cm), goingCm = floor(run / n) (run = plan distance from the side opposite RoofSpec.high to high) by §6.5 integer arithmetic; k-th riser top at floor(k x rise / n), head tread takes run's remainder (run - n x goingCm); read by stairFlight (n - 1 tread lines), glTF/OBJ/CityJSON stair solids, V01 stair-flight hatch, V03 exterior flights (its own goingCm stays for interior stairs); rise 0 -> n = 0, no treads (a ramp).

BaseWing.on: create ST7, tiers op, W6 (stepped -> stepped); persist leaf digest; regenerate re-derived with the massing by the same draws, a tiers edit's result a fixed input of later S11 runs (base pin of edited wings); undo with wings; migrate absent before the fold: every wing on the ground, byte-identical (T-V2-50). BaseWing.solid: create ST4, ST5, tiers op solid field, cleared by stepped -> single, ovalCourt seating ring M5; as on; migrate absent -> storeyed. MassingRef.stack: create ST7 via massStepped, rewritten by every tiers op, bend and stepped mutation; read tiers op, why, exports; regenerate as the massing, a tiers edit's stack a fixed input; undo with Building.massing; migrate: stack migration row re-derives a missing stack or grade at load from wings (shape from tier 0 kind and vertex count 4 rect, 8 octagon, else round; stairs axial when stair 0 centred on tier 0's centre line, flights when along tier 0's face, none with tier 0 storeyed -> internal, none with tier 0 solid -> none; lowerRoof from tier 1's roof; top from the top wing; insetCm least ring offset of tier 1 in tier 0; grade stair 0 rise/run (none: row central grade); truncated 0), one-time shift reported.

tiers op fields (count, insetCm, top, stairs, stairWidthCm, shape, lowerRoof, solid, shrineInsetShare, centre, radiusCm): event log, wings and stack model data; regenerate as V2 §4.4's setMassing row; undo the former wings and stack; migrate by address and wing keys. Works heights of a stack: heightsAt in stack order (BCR-V2-40), derived never stored, read §8.4, §11.1, V06. ovalCourt wings: as any wing; migrate none (arena row grammar bump a declared shift for arenas only). BuildingInput.deck: S11 per call, never stored, re-read every S11 run. Stacked wing baseCm, stair ridgeCm, stack envelope (Building.heights incl. floors): rebaseStack on every re-basing path (S11, setMassing commit, tier height edit, §7.3 (a) 4 terrain operator, §7.4 warp and moveVertex, carry rule (2), crypt lift, deck re-base); a setAttr of a stacked wing's baseCm bends to its support's height; a deck building's baseCm by the datum step from DeckContext.surfaceCm, re-derived when the deck height changes.

WingRoleRow defaults for new roles (J V2C-65): tier: storeys from TierCells, through 6 (tier 0 runs through at stair 0's butt joint), dormers no, porch yes (storeyed tier 0's main door), hipInset .5, roofKinds flat 1, hip 1, pyramid 1, cone 1 (ST4 picks; W5's first allowed kind flat); shrine: storeys from TierCells.shrine, through 0, dormers no, porch no, roofKinds TierCells.shrine.roofs (default hip 1, pyramid 1, gable 1); stair: floors 0, roofKinds shed 1, through 0, dormers no, porch no.

Where stage 3 runs: massing outline() at S11 once per building in the block's batch and inside every operator re-deriving S11 on a plot (Regenerate, New random, mutation add step, build, fill, terrain or water re-fit §7.3), derivation pool or generation worker, eager model data, output Building.wings with roles and keys, massing, nextWingKey then S11's base steps (insertion and first carry, deriveBase, deriveEntrances, basement decision, yard partition, households fill), stream massing; setMassing commit at the event's fold, eager, edited wings as S11 fixed input then S11 base steps, no stream for geometric ops, family op on siteplan.mutate; composer compose(..., wings) on the wings rung (neighbourhood click, building click when wings absent or stale, visible tile at neighbourhood band or finer under elaborate view (district band draws the massing's roofscape, needs no composition), an export asking for compositions), derivation pool, lazy, streams compose.dormers, compose.porch; rooms rung only as the plan rung's input on the plan-deriving building click (J-V2.9), stream compose.rooms; roofscape at every draw at district band and finer, surface layer, 3-D exports, derived at read, no draws; mutator's wing step at every designation change (§4.7 S11 steps 1-7), eager, siteplan.mutate.

Registration: @plat/buildings registers ComposedBuildingGenerator as composed in StrategyRegistry.building (§14); from stage 3's landing the recipe's building strategy defaults to composed for new documents; a document keeps its recipe's strategy (§7.5); plan() delegates to V03's registered plan implementation. Under MFCG and FTG the massing takes family baseOutline for every class: option cell massing.composed (extension {over both, mode option}, on by default) is off there, so parity presets keep the base outline footprints byte for byte (T-V2-26) and §13.5's MFCG and FTG rows are unaffected.

Class (step 1): S10b's class-mix draw (item 71) or the assignment's shapeClass; slot role from the slot's structure (§4.7 S11); a clandestine front reads the front's row (item 63 (4)), the concealed use adds nothing to massing or composition. Owner rules: split sites (item 105 (h)) branchOf use composes as split.shop, works building as split.works (V11 §2.3); ladders (item 108) COUNT, QUARTER, GUILD members ordinary buildings of LadderStepRow.memberClass, GUILD hall composes as hall family, SIZE building as the greater class with sizeFactor in M10; custom institutions (item 104) the DR24-resolved class (V11 §3.13.2); subsumption (item 104 (h)(5), 108) extra slots.

Row key resolution chain (stated once; J-V2.34): stops at the first key whose row exists and satisfies the arrangement law for the compiled template's arrangement at this band (V2 §3.10.7); a row breaking the law is skipped and reported at load (arrangementSkip, T-V2-33). Main slot: (1) DesignationTemplateRow.composition; (2) <class>/<band> override; (3) for a v. class composition.classFamily[v. key] (a town class at a village rung plays its villageForm's v. class, V11 §3.22); (4) <templateFamily>/<band> via BuildingClassRow.templateFamily (V11 must read 'read by S11's composition resolution (V02)'); (5) default.<arrangement>/<band>. Other slots: structures[i].composition; <key>/<band> with key = composition.roleKeys[(templateFamily, name)] else [('*', name)]; outbuilding/<band>. yardPart or basement role keys have no building; attach main laid by the main slot's massing (M8b). Underground: @underground appended (<prefix>@underground/<band> else default.underground/<band>), via BuildingInput.layer. Decks: @deck appended for a non-landmark deck plot (<key>@deck/<band> else default.<arrangement>@deck/<band>); a landmark reads its class chain; a deck plot is never underground. Key reached written to MassingRef.row and Composition.row.

Band (step 3): every geometry cell read at the plot's manifested band and value (§4.11 floor rule max(field band, geometryFloor)); continuous cells interpolate between band centres along the value (§4.5), discrete switch at the cut (item 19; J-A19.43); the district's band range (item 72, §4.5 (5)) clamps the value first; rooms cells are read at the occupants' band (fieldBand and current field value; item 28 (f); J-V2.36). Significance: for every geometry cell and M10's budget the value shifts by 0.5 x bandWidth x log2(σ_use / σ_class) before interpolation (σ_use incl. V11 §3.13's x2 landmark and economicWeight 0.5-2), clamped to at most one band up and never below the plot's own value (J-V2.43; T-V2-38).

Scale and drift (step 4): every length cell x the district's buildingScale (§2.5); DriftBounds filters families and roof kinds and clamps footprint target and floors. Presets (step 5): the document's preset resolves each cell by §7.6's order; building-scope FM (BCR-V2-14) resolves only cells carrying a presets.FM entry (composition.json's V2 §3.10.8 and V11 §3.24.0's item-110 chance and offer cells, 0) and sets fantasyShapes on; zeroes no extension cell, changes nothing else.

Massing families (historical type; construction; joints; wings; closed; source): single (hovel, cottage, open-hall house, warehouse, chapel nave; one range along the frontage or gable to street when narrow; 1; no; own); L (street range with a range behind; front range through, side range abutting; butt; 2); T (hall with one cross-wing through the hall's end; butt; 2); H (hall with two cross-wings; butt; 3); U (three ranges round a yard open to rear or front; butt; 3); cross (main range crossed at its middle; NG C2; WingRoleRow.through decides; butt; 2 (3 pieces)); rectCourt (courtyard house, inn, college; four ranges, front range gate; butt; 4; closed; FM rectangle family P21); plotRing (urban courtyard house following an irregular plot; 4-8 ranges along boundary inset by half a wing; mitre; closed; own); gridWalk (accreted house; self-avoiding grid walk; butt; 1-8; FM grid-walk P21); towerHouse (tower house, tower mill, bottle kiln, polygonal chapter house; tower mass at a front corner with optional range; butt/overlap; 1-2 + tower); regularCourt (regular 4-, 5-, 6-, 8-gon ring; mitre; closed; FM regular, fantasy); starCourt (4-6 corners at jittered radii; mitre; closed; FM irregular closed, fantasy); chordArc (first chords of a regular polygon, convex to street; mitre; 2-7; FM open-chain, fantasy); row (row arrangement's quads unchanged plus optional back range; base); template, axisLocked, baseOutline (base constructions plus M8 (e) west and crossing towers and M8b attached; base); shelter (cluster structure; base item 70); drawn (rect if near-rectangle else polygon with skeleton roof; base §7.1); stepped (stepped temple, ziggurat, terraced palace, tiered tower, ruin's stepped monument; massStepped/layTiers; tier 0 and stair 0 butt; 2-9 tiers; item 110 (c)); ovalCourt (amphitheatre: two concentric rings of mitred quad slabs on an elliptical chord polygon, outer storeyed façade ring and inner solid seating ring sharing vertices, hole the floor; mitre; 24-40 (two rings of 12-20); closed; own, not fantasy J-V2.84).

Our ids for the reference's families (J-V2.47): regularCourt, starCourt, chordArc, rectCourt, gridWalk are our names; item-59 PathShapeRow ids map through BCR-V2-06's table-migration row applied before M6 ships any document, so no reference routine name survives in a table, export or document. Fantasy shapes are a toggle (J-V2.5): the three fantasy families carry weights in manor, hall, tower, mage_tower rows multiplied by the model option fantasyShapes (recipe parameter with its §7.8 control row, BCR-V2-30; off by default, D-7); off never drawn; on at row weights; FM sets it on with FM's equal weights.

Fitting: the massing works inside the slot hint H (SlotPlan.hint §2.5: behind the front-line recession item 43 and template setbacks, inside the plot, clear of other slots); nothing leaves H (T-V2-1). (1) frontage direction f = unit direction of the longest access segment among those the slot's entranceOn names (ties by segment index; length by sqrt only); n = f turned toward H's area centroid; frame (u along f, v along n) origin at the access segment's first end (§6.5 ops). (2) fit rectangle Rr = lir(H, (f, n)) width W along u, depth D along v, front nearest the access segment; rectilinear families inside Rr; plotRing follows H; fantasy families in the ellipse inscribed in Rr. (3) wing width w drawn in wingWidthM clamped w <= D, w <= W, w <= (min(W,D) - courtMinM)/2 for closed; infeasible when clamped w < max(0.8 x wingWidthM[0], 3 m). (4) orientation the frontage's (item 59 KEEP OURS); fantasy phase puts one side parallel and nearest; axis fallLine (longhouse down the slope, byre downhill; V07 hard rule) and water (mill or landing long side parallel to the water) replace it (J-V2.41). (5) rows arrive as fixedWings; only the back range is laid (M9) in the back region: plot ∩ band behind the quad's rear chain of depth max(0, coverage x plotArea / frontage - rowDepth), clipped to H.

outline(input, k) is the add step of V2 §3.9 from the empty design (base 'one path', §4.7 S11 step 7): generation and later mutation lay wings with the same functions; inputs BuildingInput (slot hint, access segments, context vector, class, drift, fixedWings for a row or cluster structure, terrain sampler, resolved row key and bands, layer and attached structures BCR-V2-24, -29); output KernelResult<{wings}> plus the MassingRef S11 writes; constants in the row or constants table (V2 §3.10.9); every draw on the massing stream with the step's creation index.

M0 pass-throughs: (a) row fixedWings (one quad or stepped quads on a slope) returned unchanged with role main and keys in order; M9 may add a back range; M11-M12 heights and roofs; entrance hint null (base rule 1: door on the flush front); segments 1. (b) shelter: one fixed wing (BCR-V2-24) role shelter; roof tent for a tent (polygon), shed for a lean-to with high on the host-wall side, gable or shed for a shack by row weights. (c) drawn: V2 §3.3's drawn row. (d) institutions: template or axisLocked runs the base construction (§2.6), parts labelled part (a template tower part takes tower); M8 (e) west and crossing towers; M8b attached structures (church porch). (e) baseOutline: base rectangle, L or T, roles main and range. (f) underground: @underground row lays single with flat roof and nothing more (V04, V05 own vaults).

M2 frame by axis (J-V2.41): frontage (default: V2 §3.4 steps 1-2); fallLine: terrain gradient at H's centroid (central differences at ± axisSampleM 2 m, base sampler §2.3) gives slope s and downhill direction g; where s > axisSlope (3 %; own; V07 longhouse) frame u = g, v = g turned toward the access side, Rr = lir(H,(u,v)), front nearest the access; main range laid along u (single the along mode whatever the frontage), its downhill ridge end (larger u) written to MassingRef.low; else frontage frame. water: nearest water-face edge (§2.7 water bodies, carved channels incl. a mill leat) within axisWaterM (50 m; own) of H's centroid gives u along it, v away from water, water side = Rr side nearest the edge, main range's long side on the water side; none within reach -> frontage frame. In both non-frontage frames the entrance hint is the main range's long side nearer the access kept by entranceHintMinCos (access-less side null, base rule decides).

M3 feasibility per family with weight > 0 (after fantasyShapes, drift families, massing.composed), w0 = max(0.8 x wingWidthM[0], 3 m): (1) geometry W >= minFrameW[0] x w0 and D >= minFrameW[1] x w0, closed families W - 2w0 >= courtMinM and D - 2w0 >= courtMinM; default minFrameW (along x into): single 1.2 x 1, L 2 x 2, T 2.4 x 2, H 3.4 x 2, U 3 x 2.2, cross 3 x 3, rectCourt 3 x 3, plotRing 3 x 3, gridWalk 2.6 x 2.6, towerHouse 1.2 x 1.2, regularCourt and starCourt 3.2 x 3.2, chordArc 2.6 x 1.6, stepped ST0's test, ovalCourt: c0 = caveaM[0], c = courtMinM, b0 = w0 + c0 + c/2, a0 = 1.15 x b0, feasible when Rr's longer side >= 2a0 and shorter >= 2b0.

M3 budget (J-V2.35): least footprint Amin at w0, least lengths and courtMinM (f0 = crossWing.fwdM[0], b0 = crossWing.backM[0], c = courtMinM, gap0 = max(walkGapM, 0.3 w0)): single 1.2w0²; L 3w0²; T 2.4w0² + w0(f0 + b0); H 3.4w0² + 2w0(f0 + b0); U 5w0²; cross 5w0²; rectCourt S² - (S - 2w0)² with S = max(2w0 + c, 3w0); plotRing (c + 2w0)² - c²; gridWalk w0(w0 + gap0); towerHouse 1.44w0² plus w0 x max(1.5w0, rangeLenM[0]) where rangeLenM[0] > 0; regularCourt and starCourt 2n tan(π/n)(c/2 + w0/2)w0 with n the least side count of weight > 0; chordArc chords[0] x 1.5w0²; row, template, axisLocked, baseOutline, shelter, drawn no test; stepped ST0's Amin; ovalCourt π(a0b0 - (a0 - w0 - c0)(b0 - w0 - c0)); infeasible when Amin > 1.1 x hi (slotBand's upper target).

M4 family: one draw (creation index 0) over families feasible by both tests, weights renormalised, ties keep row order; where some pass geometry but none the budget, the least-Amin one is taken without a draw and reported (overBudgetFamily; M10 shrinks it); none passing geometry -> M14's ladder from rung 2.

M5 sunlit choice (item 102 (d); J-V2.38): where a family draws a coin between two mirror options (L arm end, T cross-wing end, U opening front or rear with base chance uOpenFront, towerHouse corner), each option's open vector o (L: arm toward front range's free end; T: cross-wing toward hall's free end; U: -v forecourt, +v rear; towerHouse: tower toward range's far end) weights x sunBias when o·sunDir > 0.25, x (1 - sunBias) when < -0.25, else unchanged, renormalised; sunDir = plan direction of the noon sun (0,-1) south (+y north) for positive latitude (§8.4 Sun.latitudeDeg), (0,+1) negative, none at 0; sunBias 0.7 (own, extension) and 0.5 in MFCG, FTG, VG, FM (each zeroing preset carries its entry since zeroing's 0 would weight every sun-facing option 0), where the coin is byte-identical to the unbiased one; orientation never changed.

M5 slabs in the frame (cm; u0, v0 Rr's near corner and front; w drawn creation index 0 after the family, clamped; length cells drawn uniformly creation index 1 in the named order): single: if W < gableToStreetMaxFrontM and D >= W across the frontage L = clamp(rangeLenM, 1.2w, D), slab [u0 + (W - w)/2, u0 + (W + w)/2] x [v0, v0 + L]; else along L = clamp(rangeLenM, 1.2w, W), slab [u0 + (W - L)/2, u0 + (W + L)/2] x [v0, v0 + w]; fallLine and water always along u. L: front slab [a, a + Lf] x [v0, v0 + w], Lf = clamp(rangeLenM, 2w, W), a = u0 + (W - Lf)/2; coin left or right; Ls = clamp(rangeLenM, 2w, D); side slab [end - w, end] x [v0 + w, v0 + Ls] (right) or [a, a + w] (left); front through (main), side abuts (range). T: fwd, back from crossWing; hall [a, e] x [v0 + fwd, v0 + fwd + w] (main); cross [e, e + w] x [v0, v0 + fwd + w + back] (cross); e - a = Lh = clamp(rangeLenM, 1.4w, W - w), a centring the whole; coin cross-wing end; needs fwd + w + back <= D else fwd and back shrink proportionally, fails M3 at 0. H: T with a cross slab at each end, Lh + 2w <= W.

M5 slabs (cont.): U: coin with uOpenFront; Lf = clamp(rangeLenM, 3w, W), Ls = clamp(rangeLenM, 2w, D); rear-open: front slab through (main), arms [a, a + w] and [a + Lf - w, a + Lf] x [v0 + w, v0 + Ls] (range); front-open (forecourt): back slab [a, a + Lf] x [v0 + Ls - w, v0 + Ls] through (main), arms v0 to v0 + Ls - w, entrance hint the back range's side facing the frontage across the forecourt. cross: main slab [a, a + Lm] x [c - w/2, c + w/2], Lm = clamp(rangeLenM, 3w, W), c = v0 + Lc/2; cross slab [a + (Lm - w)/2, a + (Lm + w)/2] x [v0, v0 + Lc], Lc = clamp(rangeLenM, 3w, D); main runs through; cross laid as two pieces abutting (role cross, consecutive keys): three wings in two path segments. rectCourt: Lf = clamp(rangeLenM, max(2w + courtMinM, 3w), W), Ld likewise on D; path order front, rear, left, right (front and rear through, sides abut both); court >= courtMinM a side.

M5 plotRing: H simplified toward at most 8 vertices at tolerance w/4 removing only a vertex whose removal keeps the ring inside H (orient2d §3.2); each edge's line moved inward by w/2; consecutive lines intersected give path Q; rejected (new attempt M14, drawing w afresh on massing/attempt=a) unless Q simple, every edge >= 1.5w, every interior angle >= mitreMinDeg (60°), Q inset again by w/2 leaves a court each side >= courtMinM; one slab per edge, mitre joints; edge nearest the access is the gate range. gridWalk: g x g grid (g = gridCells 4) fitted to Rr, pitch p = min(W,D)/g, required p >= w + max(walkGapM, 0.3w) (else g - 1 to 3, else infeasible); starts on a random front-row cell; at each step stops with chance min(1, walkStop x max(0, segments - walkFree)) (walkStop 0.12, walkFree 0, own; stops certainly only at nine; FM values calibrated at M6c against the reference's segment distribution), else tries unvisited in-bounds neighbours in an order drawn once per step; collinear steps merge; no move from start -> single; one slab per segment; earlier segment runs through at each turn.

M5 towerHouse: coin front corner; shape by towerShape; square tower rect slab of side t = clamp(1.2w .. 2w) (role tower, roof pyramid); round polygon ring radius t/2 (roof cone); octagonal 8-gon circumradius t/2; where rangeLenM[1] > 0 an attached range (main) of length clamp(rangeLenM, 1.5w, W - t) along u (square abutting, butt; round or octagonal overlapping by 0.35 x t/2); no range: the tower is the whole building. regularCourt (fantasy): side count by sides weights, circumradius R = (min(W,D) - w)/2 x U(0.8,1), centre Rr's centre, vertices at angles θ0 + 2πk/n by dmath (§6.5), θ0 putting one side parallel to f nearest the frontage; mitre. starCourt (fantasy): corner count by weights, radius R x U(0.55,1), angle θ0 + (k + U(0.25,0.75)) x 2π/n; mitre; rejected (M14) when an interior angle < mitreMinDeg. chordArc (fantasy): k chords by chords, polygon order m = U{k+1..8}, first k chords of a regular m-gon scaled so the chain's box fits Rr less w/2, convex side toward the frontage; mitre; free ends square.

M5 stepped: massStepped (V2 §3.15.1), the one exported function the base outline builder also calls from M3a, runs this frame, slotBand, ST0 (M3 for stepped), drawTiers on creation indices 8-9, layTiers (ST2-ST7), ST8 (M10 for stepped) and the stepped attempts (M14 on massing/attempt=a) itself, returning wings and MassingRef; ST4 gives heights and roofs (M11 and M12 not run on them, no cupola), ST6 and ST7 checks, keys, hint (M13's); M7-M9 lay nothing; of M8b's attached structures an absorbed one adds its budget share and lays nothing, any other dropped and reported (attachedDropped).

M5 ovalCourt: massOval (exported by @plat/plots beside massStepped, called by the base outline builder from M3a (second fixture's arena, BCR-V2-39) and by this step from M6a, same bytes): runs the frame, slotBand, M3's ovalCourt test, the construction, M11's and M12's ovalCourt rules, M13's checks, falling to rectCourt (from M6a; base court-institution construction at M3a) on failure; w at creation index 0 (façade width); then at index 1 in order major semi-axis factor U(0.85, 1), axis ratio ρ = U(1.15, 1.4), seating depth c = U(caveaM); major axis along Rr's longer side L (shorter S), centred: a = L/2 x factor, b = a / ρ; where 2b > S, b = S/2 and a = min(L/2, b x ρ); side count n by ovalSides bracket on (a + b)/2: 12 below 10 m, 16 below 20 m, 20 above (own); outer polygon P0 n vertices at θi = π/n + 2πi/n on the ellipse (dmath) so chords (n-1, 0) and (n/2-1, n/2) are centred on the major axis; P1 each edge line moved inward by w (2 x 2 solves); P2 each P1 edge line moved inward by c clamped to at most b - w - courtMinM/2 (clamp below caveaM[0] is the M3 failure, an M14 attempt).

ovalCourt wings: façade i = quad (P0i, P0i+1, P1i+1, P1i), seating i = quad (P1i, P1i+1, P2i+1, P2i), ring-ordered with sides 1 and 3 mitred ends and 2 and 4 eaves (oblique-slab rule, every shared point one vertex, §2.6 rule 1); façade wings role range, storeyed, arcade where the row's arcade is on; seating wings role range and solid; the hole inside P2 is the court (the arena floor, typed court like any hole, BCR-V2-24, built M3a). Gates: the major-axis chord nearest the access is the main gate (façade wing role gate, seating wing laid storeyed one floor as the passage, role gate); the opposite major-axis chord's façade takes main and its seating wing the second passage (gate, one floor); entrance hint M13's rule on the main gate's façade wing outer side; no block, tower, turret, back range; segments = 2n.

Slabs from a path (oblique families): segment i from p_i to p_i+1, unit direction d_i, left normal n_i; long sides at ± w/2; at a joint corners are intersections of neighbouring side lines (mitre line through the path vertex); free ends square; segments with interior angle >= 178° merge first; slab a quad wing ring-ordered corner(start,left) -> corner(start,right) -> corner(end,right) -> corner(end,left): sides 1 and 3 ends, 2 and 4 eaves; ridgeAxis 0 (ridge joins ends' midpoints; mitred end: the path vertex). Rectilinear families produce rect wings; at a butt joint the wing whose role has higher WingRoleRow.through runs through (ties: earlier in path). The main range of a closed family (rectCourt, plotRing, regularCourt, starCourt) is the range opposite the gate (largest +v midpoint component, ties by length then path order), role main (through 2); front range keeps gate; hall, court door, chapel end read it.
